description: Agent skills and a production starter kit for building Discord bots with discord.py.
name: discord-py-skills

packages.description: Map any Discord bot job to the right skill in this pack, and the order to use them in. Use first when starting bot work, or when you are not sure which skill applies.
packages.name: using-discord-py-skills

packages.description: Build a production discord.py bot from scratch: intents, cogs, async setup, config from environment, logging, and a project layout that survives real use.
packages.name: build-discord-bot

packages.description: Add slash commands to a discord.py bot: app_commands, groups, checks, autocomplete, cooldowns, and error handling that answers the user instead of failing silently.
packages.name: slash-commands

packages.description: Build a safe SQLite economy for a discord.py bot: WAL mode, schema with migrations, atomic transactions, idempotency keys, and hourly backups.
packages.name: economy-database

packages.description: Ship a multi-language discord.py bot: per-user locale preference, locale tables, fallback chain, and the translation pitfalls that break other languages.
packages.name: i18n

packages.description: Run a discord.py bot 24/7: systemd service, watchdog restarts, log rotation, health checks, and safe restarts that never lose data.
packages.name: deploy-and-monitor

packages.description: Test a discord.py bot: unit tests for pure logic, mocked interactions for commands, and async tests with pytest-asyncio.
packages.name: testing

packages.description: Apply a Hallmark theme to a Discord bot's surfaces: embeds, web dashboard, README visuals. Use when the bot needs a look that is not Discord's default blurple on everything, when embeds from different features should feel like one bot, or when a dashboard or README page should carry the same theme. Do NOT use for the bot's logic, commands, or economy; load the skill for that job instead.
packages.name: design-with-hallmark

packages.description: Stop a discord.py bot sounding and looking AI-generated: no em dash, no invented numbers, no generic copy in replies, embeds, or code comments. Use when the user says 'my bot sounds like AI', 'make the replies sound human', 'check my bot copy', or before any reply ships. Do NOT use for visual theme or layout direction; use design-with-hallmark for web dashboards.
packages.name: antislop

packages.description: Write a small Discord bot in the .newr language and compile it with `newr build` into runnable discord.py: one bot block, slash commands with replies, and ready/member-join events. Use when the user says 'write a bot in .newr', 'newr build', 'make me a small bot', or hands you a .newr file. Do NOT use for bots that need currency, command arguments, buttons, modals, scheduled tasks, or multiple languages; use economy-database, slash-commands, or i18n for those.
packages.name: newr-language

packages.description: Add interactive components to a discord.py bot: buttons, Views, modals, selects, and pagination. Use when the user says 'add buttons', 'make a paginated leaderboard', 'my buttons stop working', 'add a form/modal', or 'add a dropdown'. Do NOT use for the command itself; use slash-commands for the command and this skill for what happens after the user clicks.
packages.name: interactive-components

packages.description: Build a web dashboard and backend API for a discord.py bot: one SQLite database shared by the bot and the API, Discord OAuth2 login gated by guild and role, live numbers with polling or SSE, and a one-screen layout. Use when the user says 'make a dashboard for my bot', 'web panel', 'bot website', 'let admins manage the bot from the web', or 'show bot stats on a page'. Do NOT use for the bot's Discord commands or embeds; use slash-commands, interactive-components, or design-with-hallmark for those.
packages.name: bot-dashboard

packages.description: A minimal working discord.py bot (/ping, /balance) with a SQLite economy and a passing test suite. Installs into ./starter-bot in the current directory.
packages.name: starter-bot
